uniScholarships.title: PoliMi: Platinum and Gold (master's, 2027/28)
uniScholarships.text: For English-taught master's: Platinum 10 000 € (10 awards) and Gold 8 000 € (18 awards), both with a full tuition fee waiver; additional scholarships at the Piacenza, Cremona, Lecco and Mantova campuses. The admission application must be paid between 01.10 – 01.12.2026, the scholarship application by 15.12.2026, 12:00 (via Online Services). English certificate by 04.03.2027. The winner pays only an administrative fee of about 190 €.

uniScholarships.title: PoliMi: new English-taught bachelor's
uniScholarships.text: 2026/27: 4 scholarships for Cremona (Process Engineering) and 10 for Piacenza (Industrial Engineering), 5 000 € a year (gross) + tuition fee waiver, renewable for up to 3 years if conditions are met. The deadline was 04.06.2026; the 2027/28 call is expected in spring.

Up to 76 for English-taught bachelor's and master's: 8 000 € a year (gross) + tuition fee waiver (only the tassa regionale and bollo are paid); 3 years for bachelor's, 2 years for master's. No separate application: if you apply in the first admission round you are considered automatically. For students not resident in Italy with a foreign diploma. Not combined with other scholarships; to keep it you need at least 20 CFU by 30 November of the following year.

uniScholarships.title: Turin: Talents4UniTo (master's)
uniScholarships.text: 2026/27: 40 scholarships, 20 000 € in total over 2 years (gross) + tuition fee waiver (except the yearly 1st instalment). For English-taught master's without a cap on places, English at least B2. No separate application: the admission application on apply.unito.it had to be submitted by 29.01.2026. Not combined with DSU or other scholarships.

uniScholarships.title: Ca' Foscari: Honours and International College
uniScholarships.text: Honours Scholarships: in 2026/27, 8 for bachelor's and 20 for master's, 10 000 € a year + tuition fee waiver; the 2027/28 call is announced in late autumn. International College: 12 bachelor's and 8 master's students admitted every year; they pay only 1 000 € (bachelor's) or 1 500 € (master's) a year for tuition, an extra college programme and the Santa Marta residence (10 months).

uniScholarships.title: Trento: master's in international studies
uniScholarships.text: 2026/27: 2 scholarships each for the International Security Studies and European and International Studies master's, 7 200 € a year; more students get a tuition fee waiver based on ranking. The deadline was 04.03.2026.

uniScholarships.title: Unical: 132 full scholarships (master's)
uniScholarships.text: In 2026/27, 132 for foreign master's students: tuition fees, free dormitory and meals, plus a 3 600 € allowance. The 2026/27 deadline was 31.07.2026; the 2027/28 call will be announced on this page.

uniScholarships.title: Salerno: 48 scholarships
uniScholarships.text: 48 for non-EU students living abroad, 8 000 € a year in total: 1 800 € in cash + dormitory and meals worth 6 200 €. In 2026/27 the Universitaly application had to be submitted by 08.05.2026.

uniScholarships.title: Bari: 40 annual scholarships
uniScholarships.text: For non-EU students living abroad who will get a student visa: 5 000 € a year (gross), up to 2 years for master's, up to 3 years for bachelor's. The Universitaly pre-enrollment must be done on time. The 2026/27 deadline was 31.07.2026.

uniScholarships.title: Bocconi: 100% tuition fee waiver (2027/28)
uniScholarships.text: Bocconi4Access: full waiver for international first-year bachelor's and law students; there are also 20–100% reductions depending on the family's financial situation.

uniScholarships.title: Brescia: LMINT and STAR scholarships
uniScholarships.text: 2026/27: 13 LMINT for non-EU students on English-taught master's; 4 STAR for developing and listed countries. Winners are exempt from the university contribution. The deadline was 15.03.2026, 12:00.
2026/27: 5 for selected English-taught master's, 6 000 € a year (gross), renewable for the second year. The deadline was 26.05.2026.
5 for each international (English-taught) programme, 10 000 € a year (gross). For non-Italian citizens; no separate application, applicants to the programme are considered automatically.

uniScholarships.title: Catania: master's scholarships

uniScholarships.title: PoliTo: master's in mathematical engineering (2027/28)

rules: Obtained in Uzbekistan, apostilled and translated into Italian
In Italy the ISEE parificato (ISEEUP) is calculated at a CAF/CAAF recognised by the region
An application written by yourself and affidavits are usually not accepted
ISEE limit: the state maximum is 28 339,88 €, but some regions and universities set a lower limit (for example PoliMi 2026/27: 26 887,93 €)

Uzbekistan is not on MUR's list of «particularly poor countries» for 2026/27 (DM 176/2026). So Uzbek students submit full family documents: the shortcut «the family is not high-income» does not apply to them
You do not need an agency or intermediary to collect documents: ER.GO and EDISU openly warn to beware of anyone offering paid «help»
